scope: Change presentation only for view=live. Ordinary Explore/Favorites VOD detail tabs, title/actions, open/minimize/reopen, shortcut behavior, search and scroll state remain unchanged.
Remove the dedicated viewing route's always-visible detail header/action row from the video canvas. Keep its actions reachable from a thin persistent bottom chevron and an overlay control sheet.

The YouTube sheet selects already-open in-app results, not a newly invented external link form. Provide an explicit Explore action for finding more videos; preserve every existing search tab and scroll position.
Idle viewing shows a short directional instruction toward the bottom handle; the sheet provides a working Explore action instead of passive text alone.

Use a draft playing selection limited to the existing4-item cap, draft all/selected mode and channel-labeled lead. Apply watch/change explicitly; stop removes current viewer leases but does not issue an unrequested recording-cancel command.
All view keeps video-chat pairs; selected view shows the chosen video and every other live chat. Channel name is primary, title distinguishes multiple items from one channel.

Mixed VOD/live viewing is presentation-only: a nonselected VOD iframe has no separate chat, stays mounted/hidden/inert and retains the existing background audio policy. Its normal Explore detail remains unchanged.

Use stable provider/item keys and one unchanged player host tree across route, sheet, mode and draft changes. Do not portal/reparent the player to implement the sheet; no new media URL or native open/close occurs on mode changes.

Hide inactive or video-hidden content from pointer/keyboard access without changing the receiver lifetime. PlatformLivePlayer receives its existing active/videoVisible props only; shared resize changes remain Root-owned.
No new screenshot, profile, recording grouping, authentication, scheduler, source-level mute, fullscreen mechanism, or native service behavior in this batch.

controlSheet.handle: Always-visible thin chevron; pointer cursor; keyboard click/Enter/Space; pointer capture with drag threshold and click suppression. Only intentional open/close transitions, no looping pull animation.
controlSheet.panel: Centered on the handle, bounded within the viewport, overlays rather than pushes the player; top-right X/Escape closes and restores handle focus. Closing the sheet alone never stops playback.
controlSheet.help: Optional precise ? target, hover/focus overlay, four or fewer concise lines. Explain selection leaves other live chats and background audio intact.
controlSheet.actions: All/selected sliding choice and channel selector left, watch/change/stop right. Change light; stop red. No top-level duplicate permanent controls.
controlSheet.privacy: Mask channel/title and disable revealing/start actions consistently; existing running sessions/privacy mute remain owned by existing Player.

acceptance: Entering view=live removes the persistent detail header/actions from its canvas; returning to Explore restores the unchanged original detail behavior.
Idle CTA and bottom handle are actionable with pointer and keyboard; drag and click each toggle once, X/Escape restore focus, panel closes on inactive route without stopping media.
Draft selection does not start/stop players until apply. Existing global4 limit and visible capacity errors remain.
2→4 keeps the original2 component/iframe nodes; all→selected→different lead→all retains every player identity and native lease. Other live chats remain visible.
Mixed VOD/live retains the same VOD iframe; no hidden-video selection change calls pause/mute/close beyond existing policy.
All/selected grid fills bounded available height at4 items; existing Root-owned compact chat resize controls remain usable and unmodified.
No stale detail/focus or background search/scroll regression; menus/keyboard from inactive views do not intercept current view.

Whole-player fullscreen retains the exact existing Player subtree. This batch must not forcibly exit fullscreen merely to open the sheet; unrelated global-fullscreen access validation remains separate.
Run only focused YouTube regression and TypeScript after approval; no Vite/Cargo build, app launch/stop, real media or GUI actions.
Refreshed real desktop4-view/fade/minimize/tray acceptance is Root-owned and must remain pending until actually observed.
integration: No new parent callback is needed: current onViewChange('explore'), onWatchingChange and existing shared Player props suffice. Root owns compact resizing; communicate only selectors/layout constraints if needed.
